overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: no one asked to record the open-session discussion, and the law does not require the Board to offer recording, so the matter was resolved by informal action.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board denied a Conservation Commission chair the option to record an August 2016 open-session discussion held instead of an executive session.
allegations.key_passage: While individuals have a right to record open session meetings after notifying the chair of an intent to record, see G.L. c. 30A, § 20(f), no such request was made during the August 15, 2016 meeting.
